column1: # Curated: the makes of each country's motorcycle fleet, as Make:weight with an optional /trend (as in make_shares.tsv). Rounded from national registration statistics and industry associations (ACEM, MCIA, SIAM, ABRACICLO, AISI, VAMM, the Thai and Japanese makers' associations); countries without published figures share their region's mix. Makes without curated models here (Italika, Gogoro, VinFast, Ola, Ather, AKT, Motomel, Modenas and others) are left out, so their share goes to the makes listed.
